Title: Flipped
Writer: Rob Reiner, Andrew Scheinman, Wendelin Van Draanen
Actors: Madeline Carroll, Callan McAuliffe, Rebecca De Mornay
Plot: When Juli meets Bryce in the second grade, she knows it's true love. After spending six years trying to convince Bryce of the same, she's ready to give up--until he starts to reconsider.
